newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $24 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $24 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 500 million rupees ($24 million) of treasury bills it offered at the weekly auction, the bank said on Thursday.

The bank said it sold 189 million rupees of 91-day, 139 million rupees of 182-day and 172 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.44 percent, 9.30 percent and 9.51 percent, respectively.
It posted this week's effective bank rate at 9.68 percent per annum from 9.66 percent last week.
Last week, the bank sold 400 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.53 percent, 9.32 percent and 9.50 percent, respectively.
